annotations.rationale: Restart uses seed+epoch as base then reshuffle increments seed again, producing different shuffle vs fresh run at same epoch. Detection requires comparing global indices vs reference run formula — no runtime trace exposes the seed-derivation source. Per anti-ex 9: source-only.
